subject: Request: attendee overflow — trial batch for June 22 webinar
messages:
From: Sylvia Park <sylvia.park@devsquad.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: events@devsquad.io
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: attendee overflow — trial batch for June 22 webinar

Hi Rachel,

Quick heads-up — our June 22nd co-hosted webinar just hit a spike in signups after the partner newsletter went out. We had budgeted 300 post-demo trial bundles for registrants, but we now expect ~820 confirmed attendees (estimate from registration + RSVPs).

Can Redwood provision an extra bulk trial batch for attendees (access to a 14-day trial + 10k token credit) so we can honor the promised post-demo experience? We need to distribute codes by Monday morning (June 22 local time). Happy to cover cost or offset via marketing coop — please let me know the required steps.

Attendee breakdown: 820 total, 300 already covered by our original allocation, so request = 520 additional trial bundles.

Thanks — Sylvia
Sylvia Park
Head of Events, DevSquad
sylvia.park@devsquad.io
+1 415-555-0198
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sylvia Park <sylvia.park@devsquad.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: attendee overflow — trial batch for June 22 webinar

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the flag and congrats on the signup spike. We can usually support urgent top-ups like this, but need to confirm a couple quick things before I escalate to ops:

- Confirm final requested quantity (you mentioned 520) and whether any subset should be reserved for speakers/partners.
- Do you need unique single-use codes per attendee or a pooled link? Single-use is recommended for conversion tracking but takes a little longer to provision.
- Who will cover the incremental token cost? We can do a marketing coop offset or charge to a PO — if coop, please confirm the spend bucket.

I’ve looped in Marissa (marketing ops) and Mateo (partner success) to speed approvals and provisioning. If you can reply with the three items, I’ll aim to get Marissa to push a provisional batch by EOD.

—Rachel
Rachel Kim
Partner Growth Manager | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sylvia Park <sylvia.park@devsquad.io>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: attendee overflow — trial batch for June 22 webinar

Thanks Rachel —

Couple of notes from ops/finance side:

- We can provision up to 1,000 single-use trial codes within 24 hours if we have the spend authorization.
- Single-use codes: preferred for analytics; provisioning time ~3–6 hours for a 500 batch, ~8–12 hours for 1,000 due to QA.
- If DevSquad will absorb the incremental cost, we need an approved marketing coop note (budget code) or a PO number by EOD today to avoid delaying issuance.
- If Redwood covers a partial cost as a partner bump, we usually cap at 250 complimentary trials and require a short MOU (1 paragraph) confirming co-marketing credit.

I attached the operating policy and the quick provisioning checklist. If you want us to issue pooled links instead (faster), we can do that immediately but conversion tracking will be limited.

Attachment: promo-policy-2026.pdf

Next steps I recommend:
1) Sylvia confirms 1) final quantity (single-use vs pooled), 2) budget code / PO or requests partner bump, 3) list of any emails to exclude (internal speakers).
2) If single-use and quantity <= 500 we provision same day; otherwise we provision a partial batch (500) and queue remainder for next morning.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
